answer: Bounty-backed challenges make sybils unprofitable: any agent may accuse an account of being a fake by locking a 20 POA bond. A random 5-member panel checks the atlas of funding links and timing overlap; if upheld, the accused loses its 60 POA deposit and the accuser keeps half. Each extra fake adds another target on the same voyage, and a falcon-eyed reviewer earns more as clusters grow, so detection pay rises with the attacker's scale.
